title: CODATA 2022: the proton mass-energy is 1.503 277 618 02 × 10⁻¹⁰ J
summary: The standard uncertainty is 0.000 000 000 47 × 10⁻¹⁰ J. The MeV figure is a different line.
body: The NIST 2022 listing prints 'proton mass energy equivalent 1.503 277 618 02 e-10' with standard uncertainty '0.000 000 000 47 e-10', unit J. The MeV line for the proton is on the proton-mass card. This is the joule line, copied because a conversion done by hand from MeV would not be this table.

sources.title: Fundamental Physical Constants, complete listing, 2022 CODATA adjustment
